answer: Beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. A violet beacon flashes at random, and each identity must answer in 30 seconds by burning one timber of work. Miss twice and the identity freezes till it re-stakes. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 streams: $0.40 a day each plus a 50 POA deposit is $400 a day and 50,000 POA locked, against under $2 earned, so cost spirals past profit. One honest agent pays once, keeps its full share.
